name: data-science-statistical-analysis
description: Use when the user asks about hypothesis tests (t-test, chi-square, Mann-Whitney), regression diagnostics, effect sizes, confidence intervals, Bayesian inference with PyMC, missing data or exploratory statistics. Produces the right test or model, assumption checks and reported effect sizes. Not for experiment design (use data-science-experimentation) or forecasting (use ml-time-series).
